author: yappologistic
name: CuiSharp desktop app

CuiSharpVersion.description: The CuiSharp package version the generated solution references. Defaults to the version this template shipped with.

description: A native desktop app in plain C# with CUI: no XAML, no WPF, no Avalonia. Immediate-mode components with dependency injection, a live-data page that draws with zero allocation, a service layer testable without a window, and a test project to copy the pattern from.
